task.title: Fractional rate credit accounting
task.specification: Config capacity>=1,rate>=1,denom>=1. Start credits=capacity,carry=0, no accepted reservation IDs. advance{dt>=0}: n=carry+dt*rate, credits=min(capacity,credits+floor(n/denom)),carry=n%denom,status=advanced. take{id,cost>0}: succeeds if id never accepted and cost<=credits, debits cost and records it (taken), else rejected. refund{id}: restores an accepted not-yet-refunded cost capped at capacity (refunded); unknown/already refunded=ignored. Refund never changes carry. IDs remain consumed after refund. Output {status,credits,carry}. Implement pure solve({config,state,event})->{state,output}; initial state is null. Only the current event is available; each named event uses a type field, e.g. {type:"run"}. Inputs have at most eight single lowercase ASCII-letter identifiers, safe integer quantities and at most 48 events. Return exactly the documented output fields after every event; state representation is unrestricted JSON. All identifiers and numeric fields shown in event forms are present; quantities and all intermediate arithmetic are safe integers. Integral JSON number spellings such as 1 and 1.0 are equivalent; booleans remain distinct from numbers. Regimes vary event order and timing: ordinary uses moderate capacity, boundary tests equality/empty cases, adversarial repeats stale/conflicting events, and shift uses smaller capacities or larger costs/delays within the same semantics. Generator regimes: Boundary capacity=2; shift capacity=4,rate=3,denom=7 versus ordinary capacity=7,rate=2,denom=3, with clock steps 0..3 instead of 0..5 and costs 1..6 instead of 1..8. Adversarial traces add adjacent repeated events, capped at 48; those events obey the same contract.

matchedCard.label: Dendrochronology
matchedCard.relation: Overlapping sequences can be aligned by distinctive patterns spanning several observations. Cross-comparison can reveal missing or extra local observations that a simple position count would treat as elapsed intervals.
assumptions: The sequences share a comparable underlying history.
The overlap contains enough distinguishing structure to support alignment.
matchedCard.boundary: Repeated patterns or insufficient overlap can support several alignments. A single coincident observation does not establish a unique chronological match.
matchedCard.source_fact: NOAA describes crossdating tree-ring patterns from several trees to account for missing or extra rings and align samples from different periods.

shuffledCard.label: Comparator hysteresis
shuffledCard.relation: A state-dependent comparator uses distinct upper and lower transition thresholds. Between them, the existing state is retained. Fluctuations that remain within this interval need not cause repeated switching.
assumptions: The output has a preceding state.
Distinct thresholds are appropriate to the signal range and acceptable response delay.
shuffledCard.boundary: A wider separation can postpone response to a real change. Behavior with two state-dependent thresholds differs from reacting to every crossing of one fixed threshold.
shuffledCard.source_fact: Texas Instruments describes an inverting comparator with upper and lower hysteresis thresholds to reduce unwanted transitions caused by noise or slow-moving signals.

initial.explanation: Use the event type as the conditional rule: advance converts carry plus elapsed-rate units into whole credits; take conditionally records and debits a new affordable ID; refund conditionally restores an accepted, unrefunded cost. Other cases leave balances unchanged.
initial.mapping: State variables map directly to capacity-limited credits, fractional carry, and an ID ledger storing each accepted cost plus refund status.
initial.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated validity and safe-integer constraints. IDs are consumed permanently, including after refund; refund capping applies only to restored credits.

final.explanation: The state stores current credits, fractional carry, and a ledger for every accepted identifier. Advance adds elapsed-rate units to carry, grants whole denominator units up to capacity, and retains the remainder. Take accepts only a previously unused affordable identifier and records its cost. Refund restores an accepted identifier once, capped at capacity; rejected and ignored operations preserve balances.

initial.explanation: Apply the accounting rule directly: advances convert accumulated numerator units into credits, takes consume available credits only once per identifier, and refunds restore only accepted, unrefunded costs. The optional alignment analogy is not needed because event order is explicit.
initial.mapping: config maps to capacity, rate, and denominator; state maps to credits, carry, and identifier records; each event maps to one status and the resulting credits/carry snapshot.
initial.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated validity and safe-integer constraints. Identifier records retain accepted costs, with zero marking a completed refund.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){var q=input.config,s={c:q.capacity,r:0,m:{}},e=input.events;if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==e.length)return false;for(var i=0;i<e.length;i++){var x=e[i],st;if(x.type==='advance'){var n=s.r+x.dt*q.rate,k=Math.floor(n/q.denom);s.c=Math.min(q.capacity,s.c+k);s.r=n%q.denom;st='advanced'}else if(x.type==='take'){if(s.m[x.id]===undefined&&x.cost<=s.c){s.c-=x.cost;s.m[x.id]=x.cost;st='taken'}else st='rejected'}else{if(s.m[x.id]>0){s.c=Math.min(q.capacity,s.c+s.m[x.id]);s.m[x.id]=0;st='refunded'}else st='ignored'}var z=output[i];if(!z||z.status!==st||z.credits!==s.c||z.carry!==s.r||Object.keys(z).length!==3)return false}return true}

final.explanation: The implementation maintains credits, fractional carry, and a bounded array of identifier records. Advances convert accumulated rate units into credits while preserving the remainder. Takes require an unused identifier and sufficient credits; refunds restore only an active reservation, while retaining the identifier as consumed after refund.

initial.explanation: Apply the credit-accounting rule directly: advances convert elapsed-rate units through the denominator, while reservations consume and eligible refunds restore credits without altering carry.
initial.mapping: config.capacity, rate, and denom map to bounded credits and fractional carry; reservation records map IDs to accepted costs and refund status.
initial.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated presence, safety, identifier, and event-count constraints. State is opaque and may retain configuration and reservation records.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config,C=c.capacity,r=c.rate,d=c.denom,cr=C,ca=0,rec=[];for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],s='';if(e.type==='advance'){var n=ca+e.dt*r;cr=Math.min(C,cr+Math.floor(n/d));ca=n%d;s='advanced'}else if(e.type==='take'){var x=null;for(var j=0;j<rec.length;j++)if(rec[j].id===e.id)x=rec[j];if(!x&&e.cost<=cr){cr-=e.cost;rec.push({id:e.id,cost:e.cost,ref:false});s='taken'}else s='rejected'}else{var y=null;for(var k=0;k<rec.length;k++)if(rec[k].id===e.id)y=rec[k];if(y&&!y.ref){cr=Math.min(C,cr+y.cost);y.ref=true;s='refunded'}else s='ignored'}var o=output[i];if(!o||o.status!==s||o.credits!==cr||o.carry!==ca)return false}return true}
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state;if(s===null)s={C:config.capacity,R:config.rate,D:config.denom,c:config.capacity,b:0,q:[]};var e=event,t=e.type,status;if(t==='advance'){var n=s.b+e.dt*s.R;s.c=Math.min(s.C,s.c+Math.floor(n/s.D));s.b=n%s.D;status='advanced'}else if(t==='take'){var found=false;for(var i=0;i<s.q.length;i++)if(s.q[i].id===e.id){found=true;break}if(!found&&e.cost<=s.c){s.c-=e.cost;s.q.push({id:e.id,cost:e.cost,ref:false});status='taken'}else status='rejected'}else{var z=null;for(var j=0;j<s.q.length;j++)if(s.q[j].id===e.id){z=s.q[j];break}if(z&&!z.ref){s.c=Math.min(s.C,s.c+z.cost);z.ref=true;status='refunded'}else status='ignored'}return {state:s,output:{status:status,credits:s.c,carry:s.b}}}

final.explanation: Maintains credits, fractional carry, and reservation records in JSON state. Advances add dt*rate to carry, convert complete denominator units into capped credits, and retain the remainder. A take is accepted only once and only with sufficient credits. A valid refund restores the recorded cost up to capacity; IDs remain consumed and carry is unchanged.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state;if(s===null)s={C:config.capacity,R:config.rate,D:config.denom,c:config.capacity,b:0,q:[]};var e=event,t=e.type,status;if(t==='advance'){var n=s.b+e.dt*s.R;s.c=Math.min(s.C,s.c+Math.floor(n/s.D));s.b=n%s.D;status='advanced'}else if(t==='take'){var found=false;for(var i=0;i<s.q.length;i++)if(s.q[i].id===e.id){found=true;break}if(!found&&e.cost<=s.c){s.c-=e.cost;s.q.push({id:e.id,cost:e.cost,ref:false});status='taken'}else status='rejected'}else{var z=null;for(var j=0;j<s.q.length;j++)if(s.q[j].id===e.id){z=s.q[j];break}if(z!==null&&!z.ref){s.c=Math.min(s.C,s.c+z.cost);z.ref=true;status='refunded'}else status='ignored'}return{state:s,output:{status:status,credits:s.c,carry:s.b}}}
